title: D-Scope: Decomposing and Steering Diffusion Transformers with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2609.39625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal visual structure in diffusion transformers (DiTs), but interpreting a feature does not establish whether it can be used to control generation. We introduce D-Scope (Diffusion Scope), a framework that connects feature interpretation to generation control through shared visual evidence. D-Scope aggregates SigLIP~2 embeddings of highly activating image patches into visual centroids. Matching target text descriptions against these visual centroids in the shared image-text embedding space then enables retrieval of individual features without per-feature text annotations. The underlying patches provide evidence for inspecting each selection, while spatially masked interventions test the corresponding decoder direction at varying strengths under fixed generation conditions. We characterize 150 SAEs across two model families and five layers, and introduce a benchmark of 100 target concepts with ten contexts ea

translated_title: D-Scope：利用稀疏自编码器分解与引导扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）能够揭示扩散Transformer（DiTs）中的视觉结构，但仅仅解释一个特征并不能证明它可以用于控制生成过程。我们提出了D-Scope（Diffusion Scope），这是一个通过共享视觉证据将特征解释与生成控制相连接的框架。D-Scope将高度激活图像块的SigLIP 2嵌入聚合为视觉质心。通过在共享的图文嵌入空间中将目标文本描述与这些视觉质心进行匹配，无需对每个特征单独进行文本标注即可检索出各个特征。底层图像块为审查每个选择提供了证据，同时空间掩码干预在固定生成条件下以不同强度测试相应的解码器方向。我们表征了来自两个模型家族、五个层的150个SAE，并引入了一个包含100个目标概念、每个概念具有十种上下文的基准测试（原文此处截断）。
tldr: D-Scope框架通过将高激活图像块的视觉质心与文本描述匹配来实现无需标注的特征检索，并借助空间掩码干预验证，从而将稀疏自编码器的特征解释与扩散Transformer的生成控制真正连接起来。
en_tdlr: D-Scope bridges SAE feature interpretation and generation control in diffusion transformers by matching text descriptions to visual centroids of activating patches for annotation-free feature retrieval, validated through spatially masked interventions.
